The '''Vagaari attack force''' was the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Fleet/Legends|formation]] of the [[Vagaari Empire]]. Former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] speculated that the attack force included several [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] heavy [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari attack force was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]''.<ref name="SQ" />
